_transfer_overrides_note: Global defaults applied to every Fusion FA bookTransfer / transferAsset call.  Per-row TARGET_LOCATION_ID / TARGET_EXPENSE_CCID from BIP still win.  Note: do NOT set conversion_rate_type globally — it is ledger-specific.  When unset the parameter is omitted, which is required for same-currency transfers and for ledgers that don't publish that rate type.
_transfer_overrides_by_book_note: Per-book overrides, keyed by book code (case-insensitive).  Each entry may carry an 'applies_to' flag controlling when its values are layered onto the payload: 'T' (target, default) for inbound transfers into this book, 'S' (source) for outbound, 'B' for both.  Source overrides apply first; target overrides win when both supply the same key.  Books not listed transfer with no per-book values.
_post_transfer_attribute_update_note: Opt-in follow-up after a successful cross-book bookTransfer.  Resolves the destination asset_id in this order: (1) custom BIP report (dest_lookup_bip) - recommended; (2) X_NEW_ASSET_ID etc. on the bookTransfer response; (3) X_NEW_ASSET_NUMBER + getAssetInformation against target book; (4) fallback to source asset_number against target book.  Then calls processTransaction-updateAssetDescriptiveDetails with the bumped value.  Suffix rule: 'X' -> 'X_1', 'X_1' -> 'X_2', etc.  Default off.

post_transfer_attribute_update._source_field_note: Lower-case DFF name as it appears on the X_<NAME> field of getAssetInformation.  Captured into AssetState.attributes by scanning every X_ATTRIBUTE* AND X_CAT_ATTRIBUTE* on the response.  Common values: 'attribute7', 'attribute10' (standard FA DFF) or 'cat_attribute7', 'cat_attribute_date1' (category DFF — what Citadel uses).  Mirror this in fusion_parameter below (P_<UPPERCASE>).
post_transfer_attribute_update._fusion_parameter_note: Matching P_<NAME> bind parameter for processTransaction-updateAssetDescriptiveDetails.  Must mirror source_field.  P_CAT_ATTRIBUTE7 for category DFF, P_ATTRIBUTE7 for standard FA DFF.
post_transfer_attribute_update._skip_when_source_empty_note: When the source asset's source_field is empty / null, skip the bump entirely instead of sending '_1'.  Default true.  Set false only if you genuinely want '_1' as the seed value on assets that arrived with no tag.
post_transfer_attribute_update._dest_lookup_bip_note: Recommended: a small custom BIP report that joins source asset_id + target book and returns the freshly-created destination asset.  Canonical SQL is in sql/get_transferred_asset.sql (uses FA_BOOK_TRANSFER_DISTS — the source-to-destination mapping table for cross-book transfers, NOT FA_ASSET_HISTORY).  Column names below must match the report's G_1 XML element names (BIP uppercases SELECT aliases by default, so the report ships NEW_ASSET_ID and NEW_ASSET_NUMBER).  Placeholders ${source_asset_id}, ${source_asset_number}, ${source_book_type_code}, ${target_book_type_code}, ${transfer_to_entity} are interpolated at call time.  When this block is omitted the pipeline falls back to reading X_NEW_ASSET_ID from the bookTransfer response.
